text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Craft! Let's get right to 
it—we've got a present for you! What do 
you think it is? Take a guess!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I-I don't know...!! Hmmm, birthday, 
birthday... Ah, for now, cake!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wrong! There's that too, but the present 
is something else."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We gave serious thought to what might be 
genuinely useful to you, Craft-san. Based 
on your daily routines, habits, and manner 
of speech—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The answer I've derived is... 'Sunbathing 
Goods.'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I mean, sure, I love sunbathing, 
but... merch?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I heard that in the past, Craft-san was 
enjoying sunbathing so much that she ended 
up falling sound asleep.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You were drooling, getting bitten by 
bugs... Fufu, you really let your guard 
down, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I never slack off on scouting my rivals♪ 
Anyway, please use this pillow and 
mattress! They're super portable and high 
quality!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Next, we have herbal water. It acts as an 
insect repellent, so you won't be bothered 
by any itchy bug bites.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh~!? I'm gonna fall asleep even more 
now! Thank you sooooo much though~!!
